title: A licensee's adherence to the most current standards established by each USP chapter, unless otherwise regulated by the Board
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 9.01(3), unless otherwise regulated by the Board, a licensee shall adhere to the most current standards established by each chapter of the United States Pharmacopeia ("USP"). The paragraph names no edition, date, transition period or grace period, does not mention the National Formulary, and does not define licensee.
exam_relevance: Tests that 247 CMR 9.01(3) binds a licensee to the most current standards established by each USP chapter, and that the duty yields where the Board has otherwise regulated.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy regulations

exceptions: Unless otherwise regulated by the Board.
common_confusions: The duty runs to the most current standards established by each chapter, not to a particular edition.
The only qualifier the paragraph states is unless otherwise regulated by the Board.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-16 in the Board of Registration in Pharmacy's publication of 247 CMR 9.00 on mass.gov (PDF, Mass. Register #1536, 12/6/2024).
